geometry.sampling: uniform CIC gather points; bounds are sample centres

conventions.selection: central active slice encounter, final substep, pre-kick
conventions.scope: single source slice; not whole-bunch or diagonal-averaged field
conventions.timing: elapsed_s is the displayed end-diagonal timestamp; field timing is the exact encounter ordinal and pre-kick phase; no physical field sample time is inferred
conventions.z: nominal_z_nm is native encounter-cell centre; no longitudinal field reconstruction
conventions.normalization: ElectricFieldCIC includes one-half of differentiated native potential; primary kick is delta_v=-2*E_CIC*step/E_particle; native kernel embeds charge_sign

longitudinal.selection: all active source-slice encounters, final substep, pre-kick
longitudinal.timing: field samples are post-solve/pre-kick on the final substep; particles are displayed after the diagonal barrier
longitudinal.z_mapping: source-specific nominal slice bands under the legacy particle-dump z convention; raw encounter z is retained separately

snapshot.selection: all primary source slices at every saved diagonal
snapshot.timing: post-diagonal; all source copies drift-synchronized with the sampled particle display
snapshot.model: quasi-static native transverse slice-field reconstruction; primary sources only; not a full 3D electromagnetic field
snapshot.normalization: same native macro charge, CIC deposition, Green kernel and half-gradient gather; no sum of source magnitudes
snapshot.domain: native main transverse grid; excluded source particles counted per slice; no outside-grid field extrapolation
